We've got the Saturday evening slot at the Orpheum, three-camera setup, festival archive reuse, sponsor product display on stage, and a general caption feed in the current draft. transcript.text: I need to flag a critical technical finding before we proceed. My completed radio-frequency survey found that wireless roaming camera links interfere with the Orpheum Theater's assistive-listening loop. Because of this, the gala must use three fixed wired cameras operating from the marked camera platforms — no wireless roaming cameras. I filed the survey in the technical folder, but I want to make sure it's reflected on Mara's draft lock sheet, since it directly impacts both the camera setup and accessibility considerations.

transcript.text: I have a critical rights issue to flag. I received the countersigned performance license this morning, and it permits the gala broadcast but explicitly prohibits any video-on-demand release or later promotional clips. The recording must be marked broadcast-only. This directly conflicts with the current draft package's provision permitting the recording to be reused in the festival archive. I have not yet entered this restriction in the rights tracker, but the festival archive reuse as currently drafted would violate the license terms.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to flag two critical talent constraints from the headliner's agent that I have confirmed in email but haven't yet entered into the production schedule. First, the headliner can only soundcheck at exactly 3:00 PM on Saturday — no other time slots are available. Second, the headliner's rider explicitly prohibits any sponsor product placement anywhere on the performance stage. This directly conflicts with the current draft package's sponsor product display on stage provision.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: I have a critical accessibility requirement to flag. My accessibility vendor confirmed that the live caption feed requires the captioner to work from Booth B, whose dedicated return feed is connected to the gala's caption encoder. The general plan's control-room location will not work for the caption feed. I documented the vendor confirmation in the accessibility file, but I have not yet added the booth assignment to the lock sheet. This needs to be reflected on Mara's lock sheet before final approval.
transcript.speaker: A5
